digitization_review.notes: This index is an evidence navigator and was not a proven complete inventory of all original report graphics. Named 45 POD approvals have two source PDF pages, and the 0.01–12.31 discrepancies are flagged. Source-only items include nonnumeric drawings, governance diagrams and raster maps; do not label them numerically digitized.
